examples: Please don't exaggerate the problem; it's a small issue that we can fix in an hour.
لطفاً در مورد مشکل اغراق نکن؛ این مسئله کوچکی است که می‌توانیم در یک ساعت حلش کنیم.
Travelers sometimes exaggerate the dangers of a trip just to make their stories more exciting.
مسافران گاهی برای جالب‌تر کردن داستان‌هایشان خطرات سفر را اغراق می‌کنند.
He exaggerated how much the repair would cost, so the final bill surprised everyone.
او هزینه تعمیر را اغراق کرده بود، به همین دلیل صورت‌حساب نهایی همه را شگفت‌زده کرد.
miniContext: People often exaggerate small details to make a story more entertaining. A fisherman might exaggerate the size of the fish that got away, turning a modest catch into a legend. Advertisers sometimes exaggerate a product's benefits, which is why reading reviews carefully matters. Learning not to exaggerate helps keep everyday conversations honest and believable.

examples: As an amateur photographer, she still manages to take stunning sunset pictures.
او با وجود اینکه یک عکاس آماتور است، موفق می‌شود عکس‌های فوق‌العاده‌ای از غروب آفتاب بگیرد.
The tournament is open to both professional and amateur chess players.
این مسابقه هم برای بازیکنان حرفه‌ای شطرنج و هم برای بازیکنان آماتور باز است.
Though she was only an amateur, her landscape paintings hung in several local galleries.
با اینکه او فقط یک آماتور بود، نقاشی‌های منظره‌اش در چند گالری محلی به نمایش گذاشته شده بود.
miniContext: An amateur is someone who does an activity for enjoyment rather than as a paid profession, though the word can also describe work that still needs polishing. A weekend amateur might spend years perfecting a hobby without ever competing professionally. Some amateur astronomers have even helped scientists discover new comets. Being an amateur doesn't mean being unskilled; it just means passion comes before a paycheck.

examples: Your passport must be valid for at least six months before you can enter the country.
گذرنامه شما باید حداقل شش ماه اعتبار داشته باشد تا بتوانید وارد آن کشور شوید.
The professor said my argument was valid but needed more supporting evidence.
استاد گفت استدلال من معتبر است اما به شواهد بیشتری نیاز دارد.
This coupon is only valid until the end of the month.
این کد تخفیف فقط تا پایان ماه معتبر است.
miniContext: Something is valid when it meets the necessary requirements or follows sound logic. A driver's license is only valid if it hasn't expired. In an argument, a conclusion is valid only if it actually follows from the evidence presented. Checking whether a ticket, an ID, or a claim is still valid can save people a lot of trouble later.

examples: The critics called the film mediocre, saying it had a weak script despite good acting.
منتقدان فیلم را متوسط و معمولی توصیف کردند و گفتند با وجود بازی خوب، فیلم‌نامه ضعیفی داشت.
I expected the restaurant to be amazing, but the food was just mediocre.
انتظار داشتم رستوران فوق‌العاده باشد، اما غذا فقط متوسط بود.
He received a mediocre grade on the test because he hadn't studied enough.
او در امتحان نمره‌ای متوسط گرفت چون به‌اندازه کافی مطالعه نکرده بود.
miniContext: Mediocre describes something that is neither particularly good nor particularly bad, just average. A mediocre performance at an audition rarely gets a callback, no matter how hard the performer tried. Critics often reserve the word mediocre for films or books that had real potential but fell flat. Settling for mediocre work can be tempting under a tight deadline, but it rarely satisfies anyone in the long run.

examples: She was reluctant to share her opinion in front of the whole class.
او برای بیان نظرش جلوی تمام کلاس بی‌میل و مردد بود.
Many customers are reluctant to buy a product without reading reviews first.
بسیاری از مشتریان بدون خواندن نظرات دیگران برای خرید یک محصول مردد هستند.
After the accident, he became reluctant to drive on the highway again.
بعد از تصادف، او برای رانندگی دوباره در بزرگراه بی‌میل شد.
miniContext: Being reluctant means hesitating or feeling unwilling to do something, often out of fear or doubt. A shy student might be reluctant to raise a hand even when they know the answer. Investors can grow reluctant to put money into a risky market after a big loss. Over time, encouragement and small successes can turn a reluctant beginner into a confident expert.

examples: Airport security has become much stricter since new scanning equipment was installed.
امنیت فرودگاه از زمان نصب تجهیزات اسکن جدید بسیار سخت‌گیرانه‌تر شده است.
A steady job gives many people a sense of financial security.
داشتن شغل ثابت برای بسیاری از افراد حس امنیت مالی ایجاد می‌کند.
The company hired extra security to protect the building during the concert.
شرکت نیروی امنیتی بیشتری برای محافظت از ساختمان در طول کنسرت استخدام کرد.
miniContext: Security refers to the state of being protected from danger, risk, or loss. Banks invest heavily in security systems to prevent theft and fraud. A stable income gives families a sense of long-term security. Beyond locks and guards, emotional security in relationships matters just as much as physical safety.

examples: The old television was too bulky to fit in the moving van.
تلویزیون قدیمی خیلی جاگیر بود و در وانت اسباب‌کشی جا نمی‌شد.
Winter coats tend to be bulky, which makes them hard to pack for a trip.
کاپشن‌های زمستانی معمولاً جاگیر هستند که همین باعث می‌شود بسته‌بندی‌شان برای سفر سخت باشد.
She preferred a lightweight laptop instead of the bulky one she used in college.
او به‌جای لپ‌تاپ جاگیری که در دانشگاه استفاده می‌کرد، یک لپ‌تاپ سبک‌وزن ترجیح داد.
miniContext: Bulky describes something large and awkward to carry or store, even if it isn't particularly heavy. Moving a bulky sofa through a narrow doorway usually takes more than one person. Online shoppers sometimes avoid bulky furniture because shipping costs so much. Manufacturers keep trying to make bulky equipment, like old printers, smaller and more convenient.

examples: The market offers a wide variety of fresh fruits and vegetables every morning.
بازار هر روز صبح تنوع زیادی از میوه و سبزیجات تازه ارائه می‌دهد.
Teachers often add variety to their lessons to keep students interested.
معلمان معمولاً برای حفظ علاقه دانش‌آموزان به درس‌هایشان تنوع اضافه می‌کنند.
The restaurant's menu has such a variety of dishes that it took us ages to choose.
منوی رستوران تنوع آن‌چنانی از غذاها دارد که انتخاب کردن مدت‌ها طول کشید.
miniContext: Variety means having many different kinds of something rather than just one. A balanced diet includes a variety of fruits, vegetables, and proteins. Streaming services attract more viewers by offering a huge variety of shows and movies. Without some variety, even an exciting job can start to feel repetitive.

examples: A prominent scientist was invited to speak at the university's graduation ceremony.
یک دانشمند برجسته برای سخنرانی در مراسم فارغ‌التحصیلی دانشگاه دعوت شد.
The new building has a prominent position right in the center of downtown.
ساختمان جدید موقعیتی برجسته دقیقاً در مرکز شهر دارد.
His role in the negotiations made him a prominent figure in local politics.
نقش او در مذاکرات، او را به چهره‌ای برجسته در سیاست محلی تبدیل کرد.
miniContext: Prominent describes someone or something that stands out because of importance, size, or visibility. A prominent landmark, like a tall clock tower, can help visitors find their way around an unfamiliar city. Historians often study the decisions of prominent leaders to understand how major events unfolded. Her prominent role in the project meant that colleagues frequently asked for her opinion.

examples: Few plants can survive the harsh winters in this part of the mountains.
گیاهان کمی می‌توانند در این بخش از کوهستان در برابر زمستان‌های سخت زنده بمانند.
The small business managed to survive the economic downturn by cutting unnecessary costs.
آن کسب‌وکار کوچک با کاهش هزینه‌های غیرضروری موفق شد از رکود اقتصادی جان سالم به در ببرد.
Doctors said the patient would survive the surgery as long as there were no complications.
پزشکان گفتند بیمار تا زمانی که عارضه‌ای رخ ندهد، از عمل جراحی جان سالم به در خواهد برد.
miniContext: To survive means to continue living or existing despite difficult or dangerous conditions. Desert animals have adapted special ways to survive extreme heat and little water. Many small shops struggled to survive during the pandemic, while others adapted by selling online. Whether it's a storm, an illness, or a tough year financially, the instinct to survive pushes people to adapt.

examples: It felt weird going back to my old school after so many years.
برگشتن به مدرسه قدیمی‌ام بعد از این همه سال حس عجیبی داشت.
There was a weird noise coming from the basement last night.
دیشب صدای عجیبی از زیرزمین به گوش می‌رسید.
His sudden decision to quit the job seemed weird to all his coworkers.
تصمیم ناگهانی او برای ترک شغل برای همه همکارانش عجیب به نظر می‌رسید.
miniContext: Weird describes something strange or unusual, often in a way that's hard to explain. A weird dream can stick in your memory long after you wake up. Visiting a place you only knew from old photographs can feel weird, as if time stood still there. Scientists sometimes describe newly discovered deep-sea creatures as weird simply because nothing else looks quite like them.

examples: It was obvious that she had been crying before the meeting started.
واضح بود که او قبل از شروع جلسه گریه کرده بود.
The solution to the puzzle was so obvious that everyone felt silly for missing it.
راه‌حل آن معما آن‌قدر واضح بود که همه از ندیدنش احساس خنگی کردند.
There is an obvious difference in quality between the two brands of shoes.
تفاوت واضحی در کیفیت بین این دو برند کفش وجود دارد.
miniContext: Obvious means easy to see or understand, without needing much explanation. It was obvious from his tired eyes that he hadn't slept well. Sometimes the obvious answer to a problem gets overlooked because people assume the solution must be more complicated. Good teachers know how to explain things so that even difficult ideas eventually feel obvious.
